title: deal-playbook-1on1-daybook-aisha-patel
content:
Purpose: quick-run daybook for my weekly 1:1 with AE (Janelle) + SE (Marcus) — align on high-risk deals, blockers to close, escalation plan for Solstice Health (priority), and immediate next steps. This is a scratchpad: incomplete sentences, TODOs, parking-lot items.

Context snapshot (quick read):
- Customer: Solstice Health (mid-market, digital care platform)
- Current ARR: $120k annual run-rate on pilot; expansion opportunity ~+$300k over 12 months if integration goes well.
- Contract status: pilot -> enterprise renewal target 2026-06-15 (90 days out).
- Primary contacts: Amira Khan (CS Exec Sponsor), Luis Ortega (Head of Eng), Priya Shah (Product PM).
- Current risk level: medium-high (implementation delays + custom auth requirements).

Metrics to surface in 1:1: (have numbers ready)
- Weekly active users on pilot: 2.1k -> target to hit 5k by renewal
- API success rate last 30d: 98.6% (but recent regression on /generate endpoint on 2026-03-03)
- Average latency tail (p95): 420ms -> target <350ms for production SLA
- Open support tickets: 7 (2 Sev2, 5 Sev3) — most noisy ticket: INC-4521 (auth handshake failure)

High-priority topics to cover:
1) Auth integration blocker (Luis):
   - Status: SE created workaround (token refresh backstop) but customer needs long-term SSO flow.
   - Ask Marcus: ETA for full SSO/Federated Auth patch (ENG-7810) and whether we can commit to a week-by-week delivery plan.
   - Escalation: if patch slips >2 weeks, propose dedicated SRE/SE office hours and extend pilot window (commercial ask).

2) Performance regression (p95 increase):
   - Root cause hypothesis: quantization fallback + new routing policy change on 2026-03-01.
   - Action: open PCR with infra (ticket CS-3124); confirm whether rollback possible for specific model variant for Solstice.
   - Ask AE: Can we offer a tech credit or SLA credit if not remediated pre-renewal? (TBD commercial leverage).

3) Stakeholder alignment & exec sponsor check-in:
   - Plan: schedule 30-min exec briefing with Amira next week to demo new observability dashboard and outline remediation plan.
   - Ask Janelle: propose 2026-03-17 or 03-19 for slot; I will draft one-pager for Amira that includes adoption metrics and risk mitigation.

4) Expansion motion readiness:
   - What Solstice needs to sign: SSO, lower p95 latency, proven throughput (10k concurrent sessions), and data residency note for logs.
   - Sales ask: define minimum deliverable (MVP) for production launch and map to engineering tickets.

Meeting agenda (30 min 1:1):
- 0:00-0:03 quick personal check-in (2 min) + confirm time goals
- 0:03-0:10 run metrics + top-3 blockers (I present numbers; Janelle/Marcus confirm)
- 0:10-0:18 deep dive: auth blocker & ENG ETA (Marcus to update)
- 0:18-0:24 commercial options if timeline slips (credits, extended pilot, alternate model routing)
- 0:24-0:28 next meetings (exec briefing scheduling + owner)
- 0:28-0:30 wrap, assign owners + confirm immediate actions

Quick prompts/questions to surface in 1:1: (short bullet prompts I can read aloud)
- "Marcus, can you walk me through the SSO patch plan and week-by-week milestones?"
- "Janelle, from a commercial standpoint, what's the most we can offer without sign-off from revenue ops?"
- "If root cause is kernel selection mismatch, do we have a cheap quick-win (token-level routing) to reduce p95?"
- "Can we commit to an exec briefing with Amira by next Friday?"

Open parking-lot items (not today unless time):
- Assess feasibility of region-pin of logs for data residency (legal + infra consult).
- Evaluate potential quantization profile that keeps quality but regains latency.
- Draft public case study template (if expansion succeeds) — speaker notes idea.

Immediate action items (capture in meeting, add owners + dates):
- Marcus: provide ENG-7810 ETA + interim mitigation plan by 2026-03-16.
- Aisha (me): draft 1-page exec brief for Amira and share by 2026-03-14.
- Janelle (AE): confirm pilot extension commercial language with RevOps and get approval range by 2026-03-18.
- SRE (assigned in ticket CS-3124): investigate performance regression and share quick rollback plan by 2026-03-15.
- Support: triage INC-4521 and produce a customer-facing incident summary by 2026-03-12.

Notes / speaking points to capture during 1:1:
- Empathy line for customer: "we know this has impacted your schedule; priority for us is restoring predictability and a clear plan"
- Use trial-close language for exec: "if we can resolve SSO + p95 under 350ms, will your team be ready for production sign-off?"
- Keep leverage: avoid promising credits without RevOps sign-off — propose options instead.

Follow-up cadence after 1:1:
- I will update Confluence playbook page (solstice-health-implementation-plan) with any new dates and owners within 24 hours.
- Quick sync (15 min) with Marcus on tech execution on 2026-03-16.
- Exec briefing scheduling: target 2026-03-19; coordinate via Janelle to get Amira times.

Personal checkpoints (1:1 checklist for me):
- Bring numbers (WAU, p95, support counts) — done: prepare spreadsheet short table.
- Be explicit about what we can/can't promise.
- Ask AE what they need from CSM to make renewal easier (be concrete).

Unresolved questions (to resolve after meeting):
- Do we have headroom to spin up dedicated capacity for Solstice before renewal, and what cost would that add? (Infra ops)
- Is there a simple config change to routing policy that reduces p95 for this customer without global impact? (Runtime team)

Quick decisions I want out of this 1:1:
- Commit to exec briefing date and owner for materials.
- Firm ETA for SSO patch or explicit approval to propose pilot extension.
- Action plan for performance rollback or mitigation.

End-of-doc quick dump of resources to attach:
- Support ticket list: INC-4521, INC-4602, INC-4677
- Engineering tickets: ENG-7810, ENG-7832
- Sales/contract: quote-solstice-v3 (draft)
- Confluence: solstice-health-implementation-plan (will update post-meeting)

Last-minute mental notes: keep tone problem-solving, not defensive. If AE pushes for commercial concessions, push for timebound remediation + mutual milestones (concession tied to telemetry).

-- Aisha (notes)
